A plot of composition profiles, Fig. 4(b), across one of the precipitates show the precipitate composition to be ~ 21.9 at.% Zr, close to the stoichiometry Al3Zr with a solubility of Ni ~ 3.2 at.% in the precipitate.
These superlattice reflections correspond to the fcc-based L12 ordering similar to that exhibited by Ni3Al phase in Ni-based superalloys [42].

A significant enrichment Zr ~ 0.16 at.% was observed at the interface relative to either α-Al or Al3Ni phase.

Atom probe tomographic (APT) investigations of the heat-treated ternary alloy unambiguously reveal segregation of Zr solute at the αAl/Al3Ni interface
The segregation hinders the interdiffusion of Al and Ni in the eutectic and, thereby, increasing the stability of eutectic phase at high temperature.
